info.name: JAS Loyalty Engine
info.description: Postman collection for JAS Loyalty Engine microservice (NestJS). Set `baseUrl` and `apiKey` (see .env ADMIN_API_KEY). Protected tenant calls send `x-api-key`; customer-session calls send `Authorization: Bearer {{customerSessionToken}}`; tenant staff calls send `Authorization: Bearer {{orgToken}}`. OTP is `123456` in local env. Shopper OTP endpoints are deprecated (410) - use `POST /customer/session` to mint a tenant-delegated session token.

item.name: Org: validate OTP (public) - OTP is 123456 locally

request.description: Returns the org JWT at data.organization.token (used by /organization/auth/set-credentials). OTP is 123456 in local/dev/stage.
DEPRECATED: returns 410 when CUSTOMER_OTP_ENABLED=false. Use POST /customer/session instead.

item.name: Customer: validate OTP - returns JWT token (DEPRECATED)

request.description: DEPRECATED: returns 410 when CUSTOMER_OTP_ENABLED=false. Use POST /customer/session instead.

item.name: Auth - Tenant Staff
item.description: Tenant staff login: username + password, then OTP, then a JWT. Set credentials once using the JWT from the organization OTP flow.

request.description: One-time credential setup. Requires the org JWT returned at data.organization.token by POST /organization/otp/validate (or data.token from /organization/auth/verify-otp). Response never includes passwordHash.
Verifies username/password, then sends an OTP to the registered mobile and returns a challengeId.
Completes tenant staff login. OTP is 123456 in local/dev/stage. Stores orgToken and organizationId.

item.name: API Keys
item.description: Manage tenant-scoped API keys. Scopes: loyalty/promo/fx/plb/exchange read+write, webhooks:manage, api-keys:manage.

request.description: Creates an organization API key. Plaintext key is returned once; scopes default to every scope when omitted. Requires the platform key (ADMIN_API_KEY) or an api-keys:manage key.
Exchanges the tenant assertion of a shopper identity for a 15m tenant-scoped customer session token. No shopper OTP is involved. Stores customerSessionToken and customerId.

item.name: Engines - Loyalty Webhooks
item.description: Webhook endpoint management, delivery audit and dead-letter retries (scope: webhooks:manage).

request.description: Registers a webhook. The HMAC secret is generated and returned once. Events: points.earned, points.burned, points.expired, points.transferred, tier.upgraded. An empty events array subscribes to all events.
Synchronous test delivery. Returns 502 if the target URL rejects the request.
